import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static final int MAXN = 33;
    static long[] bin = new long[MAXN * 2];
    static int n, m;

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] mat = new long[MAXN][MAXN];

        Matrix multiply(Matrix a) {
            Matrix res = new Matrix();
            for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                    res.mat[i][j] = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k <= m; k++) {
                        res.mat[i][j] = (res.mat[i][j] + this.mat[i][k] * a.mat[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
            return res;
        }
    }

    static int readInt(Scanner sc) {
        return sc.nextInt();
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        n = readInt(sc);
        m = readInt(sc);
        int n2 = n;
        int length = -1;
        while (n2 > 0) {
            length++;
            bin[length] = n2 % m;
            n2 /= m;
        }
        length++;
        Matrix ans = new Matrix();
        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            ans.mat[0][i] = 1;
        }

        Matrix[] P = new Matrix[MAXN * 2];
        Matrix[] S = new Matrix[MAXN * 2];
        Matrix[] A = new Matrix[MAXN * 2];

        for (int i = 0; i <= m; i++) {
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                A[0] = new Matrix();
                A[0].mat[j][j] = 1;
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < length; i++) {
            A[i] = new Matrix();
            for (int j = 0; j <= m; j++) {
                A[i].mat[j][j] = 1;
            }
            if (i == 0) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    A[i].mat[m][m] = 1;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        if (k != j) {
                            A[i].mat[k][k] = 1;
                            for (int l = 0; l <= m; l++) {
                                A[i].mat[k][l] = 1;
                            }
                        }
                    }
                }
            } else {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    if (j == 0) {
                        A[i] = S[i - 1][0];
                    } else {
                        A[i] = S[i - 1][j].multiply(P[i - 1][j - 1]);
                    }
                }
            }
            P[i] = new Matrix();
            P[i].mat = new long[m][m];
            P[i] = A[i];
            for (int j = 1; j < m; j++) {
                P[i] = P[i].multiply(A[i]);
            }
            S[i] = new Matrix();
            S[i].mat = new long[m][m];
            S[i] = A[i];
            for (int j = m - 2; j >= 0; j--) {
                S[i] = A[i].multiply(S[i]);
            }
        }

        int j = 0;
        for (int i = length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            while (bin[i] > 0) {
                ans = ans.multiply(A[i]);
                j++;
                if (j == m) j = 0;
                bin[i]--;
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans.mat[0][m]);
        sc.close();
    }
}
